prompt:
Fix snippets/warranty-status.liquid so it renders a product warranty line. It reads exactly two top-level variables (neither is under section.settings): - warranty_months: integer, may be null. - warranty_label: string, may be null, empty, or whitespace-only. Rules: 1. If warranty_months is null, or is less than 1 (0 or negative), output exactly:

No warranty

2. Otherwise output exactly:

LABEL: N UNIT

where N is warranty_months. UNIT is "month" when N is exactly 1, otherwise "months". LABEL is warranty_label with leading and trailing whitespace removed. If warranty_label is null, or is empty after removing whitespace, LABEL is "Warranty". LABEL must be HTML-escaped (& < > " become & < > "). The snippet outputs only that single element, with no leading or trailing whitespace or newlines. Never compare null with < or > (that raises an error under strict rendering). Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/warranty-status.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
